run_grpc_server: run the pybullet grpc server on localhost:12345 using the grpcPlugin
run_grpc_server_direct: run the pybullet grpc server in direct mode with manual RPC handling
load_grpc_plugin: load the grpcPlugin into pybullet and start it on a specified hostname
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to pybullet in GUI mode and set the additional search path for data
execute_plugin_command: execute a plugin command on the loaded grpcPlugin to start the server or handle RPCs
